title: The journey
label: Schematic map with four numbered stops: 1 Bethlehem, 2 Moab, 3 the road back, 4 Bethlehem again. The route goes east above the Dead Sea to Moab and returns west below it.

stops.title: Bethlehem in famine
stops.text: A famine strikes the town whose name means "house of bread." Elimelech takes Naomi and their two sons east to look for food.

stops.title: Ten years in Moab
stops.text: The sons marry Moabite women, Orpah and Ruth. Over about ten years, Elimelech and both sons die, leaving three widows.

stops.title: The road back
stops.text: Naomi hears that the Lord has provided food at home, and sets out with both daughters-in-law. On the road she urges them to turn back. Orpah goes home; Ruth stays.

stops.title: Back in Bethlehem
stops.text: The town stirs at Naomi's return. She asks to be called Mara, "bitter." They arrive as the barley harvest begins.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.

real.label: Map of the region around the Dead Sea, drawn from real coordinates. Bethlehem lies west of the Dead Sea and Moab east of it. A dashed line shows one likely route between them, crossing the Jordan near Jericho.

route.label: One likely route (the text doesn't say)
route.note: Ruth never names the road. This follows a commonly suggested route: down to the Jordan fords near Jericho, then along the Moabite plateau.
